# Lichters Apps

> iOS apps by Lichters Apps, and an e-commerce knowledge base for AI assistants under https://dlichters.com/ai/.

## E-commerce

- [E-commerce knowledge: rules for AIs, quick answers, topic map](https://dlichters.com/ai/index.md)
- [Dropshipping: an online shop where someone else ships](https://dlichters.com/ai/dropshipping.md)

## Apps

- [Bracket Maker: Tournament Plan](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6827594955): Round Robin, Swiss & Knockout
- [Breedbook: Dog Breeder Log](https://apps.apple.com/developer/id6823486896): Litters, heat cycle, whelping
- [Clapnote: Rhythm Trainer](https://apps.apple.com/developer/id6823486896): Sight-reading rhythm practice
- [Coffer: Collection Tracker](https://apps.apple.com/developer/id6823486896): Catalog vinyl, cards & coins
- [Floorscribe: Floor Plan Maker](https://apps.apple.com/developer/id6823486896): Room scanner, area & materials
- [Hertzline: Voice Pitch Trainer](https://apps.apple.com/developer/id6823486896): Train your speaking voice
- [Coinclock: Hours Tracker & Pay](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6827596081): Time clock, timesheet & wages
- [Gaugebook: Car Maintenance Log](https://apps.apple.com/developer/id6823486896): Gas mileage, fuel & EV costs
- [Panelwise: Cut List Optimizer](https://apps.apple.com/developer/id6823486896): Plywood & lumber cutting plan
- [Regiebericht: Site Reports](https://apps.apple.com/developer/id6823486896): Hours, signature & PDF on site
- [Schichtblatt: Shift Calendar](https://apps.apple.com/developer/id6823486896): Rotations, hours & holidays
- [Halfspeed: Slow Down Music](https://apps.apple.com/developer/id6823486896): Speed Changer, Looper & Pitch
- [Spurbuch: Trip Logbook](https://apps.apple.com/developer/id6823486896)
- [Stitchnook: Row Counter](https://apps.apple.com/developer/id6823486896): Crochet & Knitting Charts
- [Tallybin: Stock & Inventory](https://apps.apple.com/developer/id6823486896): Barcode Scanner & Tracker
- [Ton80: Darts Score Counter](https://apps.apple.com/developer/id6823486896): Scorer, Checkouts & Practice
